violated_contract: Deleting a conversation must remove every copy of its audio and transcript, including state keyed by the sync upload or a provisional capture identity rather than the conversation id. Sync staging (syncing/{uid}/{job_id}/, no lifecycle delete) and batch-pipeline rows carrying the capture identity survived conversation deletion; non-cascade deletes kept all audio.
canonical_prevention: Conversation deletion resolves upload-keyed storage through the sync content ledger (database/sync_ledger_sources.py) and erases it with the existing owner-prefix purge and batch purges; both cascade modes schedule the audio purge.
